games.name: 👻GHOST Troll Slap Tower
games.desc:
🖐️ SLAP TOWER [BETA] 🏰
Welcome to Slap Tower, the ultimate physics-based climbing challenge! Scale the tower, outsmart your rivals, and slap your way to the top. Do you have the fastest hands in Roblox, or will you get sent flying back to the lobby?

🔥 HOW TO PLAY:
CLIMB: Navigate tricky obstacles and moving platforms to reach the summit.

SLAP: Use your hand to knock other players off the edge!

SURVIVE: Avoid getting slapped! Use your movement skills to dodge incoming attacks.

WIN: Reach the Golden Trophy at the top to earn Coins and Wins!

⚡ FEATURES:
Unlockable Gloves: Earn coins to buy gloves with special powers (Fire Slap, Ice Freeze, Knockback Boost, and more!)

Crazy Obstacles: From spinning lasers to slippery ice floors—the tower is always changing.

Leaderboards: Compete for the title of "Top Slapper" and show off your win count.

Rebirth System: Reach the top to rebirth and unlock permanent speed and power buffs.
